title: Recycling in Our Town
text:
Our town has a new recycling program. Every family receives two bins, one for paper and one for plastic. The city asks people to separate their rubbish before putting it out on the street.

Some people think the program is too much work. However, the mayor says that recycling helps protect the environment. Many neighbours now share tips about how to sort their waste correctly.

questions.text: How many bins does each family receive in the first paragraph?
What does the mayor say about recycling in the second paragraph?
What can you infer about the people who think the program is too much work?
options: They want to stop recycling completely
They find sorting rubbish difficult or tiring
They do not produce any rubbish

questions.text: What does the sentence about neighbours sharing tips suggest about the program?
options: People are learning to work together on it
Neighbours do not like each other

vocabulary.definition: the process of using old materials again to make new things
large containers used to store rubbish
the natural world around us, such as air, water, and land

paragraph_translations: Nossa cidade tem um novo programa de reciclagem. Cada família recebe duas lixeiras, uma para papel e outra para plástico. A prefeitura pede que as pessoas separem o lixo antes de colocá-lo na rua.

Algumas pessoas acham que o programa dá trabalho demais. No entanto, o prefeito diz que a reciclagem ajuda a proteger o meio ambiente. Muitos vizinhos agora compartilham dicas sobre como separar o lixo corretamente.
